name: 循环流程图

prompt_template.subject: {cycle_topic}
prompt_template.layout: circular flow with arrows forming a closed loop
prompt_template.style: clean circular diagram with stage nodes and directional arrows
prompt_template.color_scheme: circular gradient or stage-specific hues, arrows in dark gray #374151
prompt_template.labels: stage names in bold, process descriptions in regular, phase durations in italic

circular.description: 圆形循环风格，节点环绕

overrides.layout: circular flow with 4-8 stage nodes arranged on a circle, arrows clockwise
closed loop with curved arrows and stage boxes along the loop
concentric cycles showing multiple interconnected loops

overrides.style: infographic with icon-based stages and illustrated background context

category_tips.biology: 细胞周期标 G1/S/G2/M 时长；Krebs 标产物和酶；碳循环标储库和通量
category_tips.medicine: 心脏循环标收缩/舒张；凝血级联标因子；药物代谢标 ADME
category_tips.chemistry: 化学循环标反应条件和催化剂；能量循环标 ATP/ADP；氧化还原标电子转移
category_tips.physics: 热力学循环标 P-V 图；卡诺循环标等温/绝热；电磁循环标场方向
category_tips.engineering: 控制循环标反馈回路；制冷循环标四组件；燃料电池标电极反应
category_tips.math: 迭代算法标收敛条件；递归标基例/归纳；马尔可夫链标转移概率

examples: Water cycle diagram, circular flow with 4 stages clockwise: (1) Evaporation 蒸发 from ocean with sun icon, (2) Condensation 凝结 into clouds, (3) Precipitation 降水 as rain/snow, (4) Collection 汇集 into rivers and groundwater returning to ocean. Stage nodes on circle, curved arrows between them. Blue palette #3b82f6 to #06b6d4. Illustrated background with sky, mountains, ocean. 4K, education style.

Cell cycle circular diagram, 4 phases: G1 (Gap 1, 10h), S (Synthesis, 9h), G2 (Gap 2, 4h), M (Mitosis, 1h). Phase nodes on circle, arrows clockwise. G1 green #10b981, S blue #3b82f6, G2 yellow #eab308, M red #ef4444. Checkpoint markers (G1/S, G2/M, spindle). Phase durations italic. 4K, textbook style.

Carbon cycle infographic, interconnected loops showing: atmosphere CO2, photosynthesis to plants, respiration back, decomposition to soil/fossil fuels, combustion back to atmosphere, ocean absorption. Icon-based stages with arrows showing flux values (GtC/yr). Concentric layout with atmosphere at center. 4K, publication-ready.
accuracy_tips: 循环方向正确（顺时针/逆时针）；阶段顺序符合实际；通量/时长标注准确；循环闭环无断口；阶段数 4-8 个为宜；中英文术语对照；不虚构循环过程或通量数据。
